svg.title: About Nguyễn Nam Hùng — Software Engineering student at Duy Tan University, fullstack developer.

g.text: Curious to start. Stubborn to finish.
Hi, I'm Hùng — a Software Engineering student at Duy Tan University.
I started by building websites for myself, then moved on to real problems: brand sites,
a coach-booking platform, management tools and products with AI inside.
To me a landing page must tell the right story, an app must run clearly — and an idea
only matters once someone can actually use it.
So I work the full loop: interface, backend and data — each product a little better than
